title: CONSPIRED: A Dataset for Cognitive Traits of Conspiracy Theories and Large Language Model Safety
reasoning: The paper focuses on the identification and benchmarking of rhetorical and cognitive traits specific to conspiracy theories (using the CONSPIR framework) to evaluate LLM safety and misalignment. While it deals with harmful content and includes an ethics statement, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, specific moral systems, or ethical frameworks as a primary research goal.
